users: researchers evaluating declared multimodal boiling tasks and data profiles
supported_tasks: evaluate heat-flux, regime, segmentation, and robustness tasks
link dataset cards to reproducibility documentation
not_intended_for: treating derived products as independent measurements, splitting adjacent windows from one run across partitions, or assuming weights and external data share the repository's rights

limitations: Large raw archives are distributed separately from the control repository.
Derived heat flux, temperatures, events, spectra, and synchronization products are not independent measurements.
